questions.question_text: Why is researching a company, school, or role before an interview important for high school students?

options.text: It helps you memorize every detail about the organization to impress the interviewer.
It shows genuine interest, helps tailor your answers, and reduces pre-interview nerves by making the unknown familiar.
It ensures you can avoid answering tough questions by focusing on random facts.
It guarantees you’ll get the position since you’ll know more than other candidates.

questions.question_text: When answering the question “What is your biggest weakness?” in an interview, what is the best approach?

options.text: Say you have no weaknesses to appear confident.
Choose a fake weakness like “I work too hard” to sound impressive.
Admit a real but non-critical weakness and explain how you’re working to improve it.
Avoid answering by changing the subject to your strengths.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of creating a personal cheat sheet before an interview?

options.text: To write down answers word-for-word so you can memorize them exactly.
To bring into the interview as a reference in case you forget something.
To organize key points about your skills, experiences, and goals to recall confidently during the interview.
To list every single detail of your life to share with the interviewer.

questions.question_text: How can researching a company’s social media presence benefit you during an interview?

options.text: It allows you to criticize their posts if you disagree with their views.
It gives you up-to-date insights or events to mention, showing engagement and relevance.
It helps you avoid talking about the company altogether by focusing on personal stories.
It ensures you can copy their exact wording in your answers to sound professional.
